BiblicalUsage: Ir-hat-Temarim is the city of palm trees, another name for Jericho, and the Bible calls it that in two places. In Judges 1:16 the children of the Kenite go up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah, and in 2 Chronicles 28:15 the captives are brought to Jericho, the city of palm trees, to their brethren.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name is the picture of Jericho itself: a city of palms in the desert, where the Kenites dwelt and the captives were brought home.
